name: heading
label: Heading
default:
The Visibility Build
Four pillars, one outcome.

name: intro
label: Intro
default: Every Found First engagement builds across four interconnected disciplines, mapped directly to the SEO / AEO / GEO conversation above, with the human decision-maker as the audience every pillar is ultimately written for. The pillars compound in order: skip one and the next one underperforms.

default.title: Web Foundation
default.description: The technical prerequisite. AI search engines can't cite what they can't crawl, parse, and trust. This work makes your site structurally readable to both Google and AI crawlers.

items.text: Technical SEO audit + Core Web Vitals remediation
Page speed and mobile performance baseline

default.title: Content Authority
default.description: The citation engine. AI cites the best-structured answer available, not the longest one. This pillar builds pillar pages and FAQ infrastructure in the exact format AI engines prefer.

items.text: Service pillar pages with AEO-formatted structure
FAQ infrastructure targeting ICP buying queries
Cluster content mapped to AI discovery patterns

default.title: Credibility
default.description: The trust layer, built outside your own site. AI models weight brand credibility before deciding who to recommend, and credibility gets built across every content type your brand touches. This pillar maps proof points across the full PESO model.

items.text: Earned: press mentions, third-party reviews + case studies
Shared: partner and industry association mentions
Owned: structured data + entity consistency across your own properties

default.title: Brand + Buyer Alignment
default.description: The layer that makes the other three actually land. This weaves your brand voice, persona targeting, industry credibility, and unique value into every asset, so the page checks every box for both the algorithm and the human reading it.

items.text: Consistent brand voice across every published asset
Industry insight + credibility signals woven throughout
Your unique value proposition reinforced page to page

name: compound_note
label: Compound Note (rich text)
default: Web Foundation unlocks Content indexing. Content Authority builds the signals Credibility needs. Credibility makes AI engines trust what Content Authority already published. Brand + Buyer Alignment makes sure every word in all three still sounds like you and speaks to the person reading it.
